name: Jobseeker Support Student Hardship
description: A hardship-based benefit for students experiencing financial hardship, covering eligibility, obligations, hardship criteria, sanctions, and payment rules under the Jobseeker Support framework.

attributes.summary: A hardship-based benefit for students, covering eligibility, obligations, hardship criteria, sanctions, and payment rules under the Jobseeker Support framework.
attributes.eligibility: Age requirements including 16-17 year olds with parental support gap; residence and immigration status; full-time study; income and cash asset criteria; hardship criteria
attributes.payment_details: Rate of payment for 16-17 and 18-19 year olds; charging income; deductions; absence from New Zealand; hospitalisation; imprisonment; taxation
attributes.obligations: Job search requirements; work or work preparation obligations; social obligations (primary health, early childhood education, school enrolment); drug test obligations; work ability assessment obligation; Community Work Experience; Report Job Search; Upskilling
attributes.income_test: Income and cash asset criteria applied; income abatement thresholds and cut-out points
